title: Generating Biomedical Fact-Checking Reports with RL-Enhanced Agentic Search
abstract: arXiv:2608.23811v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Automated fact-checking is essential for ensuring the reliability of public health information, yet the biomedical domain poses unique challenges. Validating biomedical claims requires rigorous interpretation of scientific literature, assessment of retrieved evidence, and comprehensive justification toward the conclusion. Although Large Language Models (LLMs) enhanced by Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and agentic search perform automated fact-checking in a retrieve-then-verify paradigm, current methods still output isolated prediction labels, lacking explanatory depth and offers limited utility for human understanding. To bridge this gap, we introduce an LLM-based agent named BioCheck Agent that generates structured biomedical fact-checking reports with agentic search. translated_title: 利用强化学习增强的智能体搜索生成生物医学事实核查报告
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.23811v1 公告类型：新 摘要：自动化事实核查对于确保公共卫生信息的可靠性至关重要，但生物医学领域带来了独特的挑战。验证生物医学声明需要对科学文献进行严格解读、对检索到的证据进行评估，并针对结论提供全面的论证。尽管通过检索增强生成（RAG）和智能体搜索增强的大型语言模型（LLMs）在“检索-验证”范式下执行自动化事实核查，但当前方法仍仅输出孤立的预测标签，缺乏解释深度，对人类理解的实用性有限。为弥补这一差距，我们引入了一个名为BioCheck Agent的基于LLM的智能体，它通过智能体搜索生成结构化的生物医学事实核查报告。该智能体不仅仅是输出支持或反驳的标签，而是综合最终结论、检索到的证据和严格分析。为确保领域专业性，...
tldr: 本文提出BioCheck Agent，一种利用智能体搜索和强化学习生成结构化生物医学事实核查报告的LLM智能体，旨在提供深入解释而非孤立标签，增强人类理解。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces BioCheck Agent, an LLM-based agent that generates structured biomedical fact-checking reports via agentic search and reinforcement learning, providing explanatory depth instead of isolated labels to enhance human understanding.
